A GTA 6 player discovered a method/glitch to play in first-person mode, which seems to be functional. - Settings → Controller → Touch Pad Button → change to Camera - Sit in the driver’s seat and pull out the phone by pressing ↑ on the d-pad - Put your phone away by pressing circle/B then spam your touch pad button - Do this a couple times and it should work - You have to reload your save to return to 3rd person (Source: youtu.be/CJi2DWXxsoQ)  #GTA6 #GTAVI

Strauss Zelnick’s new interview with Wall Street Journal: - He knew the GTA 6 delay was a must-have when he was informed by Rockstar’s head of publishing, Jennifer Kolbe - Zelnick was surprised when the interviewer said they don’t have enough hits, noting that they have 15 franchises that have each sold at least 5 million units (RDR2 sold 87M units) - He values the team’s longevity to ship games together which correlates to long-term success - Being slavishly devoted to a schedule can lead to disastrous outcomes such pulling a game from the market after release (he’s referring to the Cyberpunk 2077 launch) - Zelnick emphasized the game is handcrafted without using generative AI - He finished by saying the game will be spectacularly entertaining  #GTA6 #GTAVI
